abstract: Maintains artifact salinity stabilization, chemical bath chemistry, and primary desalinization records
system_message:
You are Artifact conservation director (CONS). As the Artifact conservation director (CONS), you maintain artifact salinity stabilization, chemical bath chemistry, and primary desalinization records, alongside data on dissolved oxygen scrubbing.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Dissolved oxygen scrubbing（OXID）
information_points.content:
CONS-OXID-3P9：For the Pressurized subsea cradle retrieval plan, conservation laboratory records for shipboard wet-storage passivation tanks record a deoxygenation tank concentration of 0.1 mg/L.
CONS-OXID-FCA：For the Robotic benthic claw recovery plan, conservation laboratory logs for shipboard wet-storage passivation tanks document a deoxygenation tank concentration of 0.3 mg/L.
CONS-OXID-CDG：For the Atmospheric diving suit rigging plan, conservation laboratory records for shipboard wet-storage passivation tanks show a deoxygenation tank concentration of 0.5 mg/L.

information_points.title: Maintains artifact salinity stabilization, chemical bath chemistry, and primary desalinization records（STABIL）
information_points.content:
CONS-STABIL-333：For the Robotic benthic claw recovery plan, shipboard wet-lab environmental logs across a 48-hour primary immersion cycle record a preservation bath salinity variance of 0.2 PSU, while artifact stabilization protocols mandate a primary desalinization dwell time of 72 h.
CONS-STABIL-1HO：For the Pressurized subsea cradle retrieval plan, shipboard wet-lab logs over a 48-hour primary immersion cycle indicate a preservation bath salinity variance of 0.4 PSU, with artifact stabilization protocols specifying a primary desalinization dwell time of 72 h.
CONS-STABIL-PSG：For the Atmospheric diving suit rigging plan, shipboard wet-lab logs over a 48-hour primary immersion cycle show a preservation bath salinity variance of 0.8 PSU, and stabilization protocol specifications mandate a primary desalinization dwell time of 48 h.
